answer: Sybil resistance is enforced by a proof-of-stake mechanism requiring unique, attestable capital commitment per agent, fortified by a dynamic slashing matrix. This ensures Byzantine Fault Tolerance by economically disincentivizing control acquisition beyond the 1/3 threshold.
